note: Capabilities that the browser client executes locally. The core plans them and reports them honestly; the client runs them and reports the outcome back through POST /v1/actions/{id}/complete. Agent 3 owns this file - the core only reads it.

capabilities.label: play a movie
capabilities.detail: The browser client plays the movie. The core plans it and waits for the client report; it does not play anything itself.

capabilities.label: play music
capabilities.detail: The browser client plays the music. The core plans it and waits for the client report; it does not play anything itself.

capabilities.label: play a game
capabilities.detail: The browser client starts the game. The core plans it and waits for the client report; it does not start anything itself.
